items.heading: Current Price
items.description: A day-ahead electricity forecasting dashboard that combines SMARD market data, CNN-LSTM inference, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and Next.js.

items.heading: Global Commodity Trade Analytics
items.description: An interactive React and FastAPI dashboard for exploring global commodity trade, country balances, product concentration, and advanced analytics from 1988 to 2016.

items.heading: Conic Lab
items.description: An interactive Three.js visualizer with a Python geometry API for exploring and classifying the curves formed when a plane intersects a double-napped cone.

items.heading: Skill Forge
items.description: An adaptive learning platform with RPG-style progression, performance-based quizzes, machine-learning personalization, and real-time skill-path tracking.
